exceptions.reason: The locked age 0.12.1 dependency uses crypto-bigint through P256/HPKE recipient code. Individual notes and wrapped journal keys require scrypt envelopes; whole-journal records use explicit X25519 recipients and identities. The reviewed X25519 implementation uses x25519-dalek, HKDF and ChaCha20-Poly1305 and ignores other recipient stanzas before key operations. MynaJournal supplies only these concrete scrypt/X25519 identities, not generic identity dispatch or P256/HPKE recipients. Reassessed for journal protection on 2026-11-09; review again if age, identity dispatch or recipient types change.

The package is in Cargo.lock for optional dependency features, but is absent from the normal/build dependency graph with all application features and all targets. CI verifies that it stays unused. SSH recipients and MySQL are not enabled.
Build-time i18n configuration dependency of the current age release. This is a maintenance warning, not a reported vulnerability; update with age/i18n when an upstream replacement is available.
